name: pr-status
description: Pane with the status of the PR this session works on: URL, reviewers, open review remarks, merge state, author/reviewer actions

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the PR status is refreshed from GitHub

reviewCommand.title: Review-again prompt
reviewCommand.description: Sent when you press Review again (reviewer mode). A leading /name runs that slash command. {url} is the PR URL

addressPrompt.title: Address-remarks prompt
addressPrompt.description: Sent when you press the open remarks count (author mode). {url}, {count}, {base}, {head}
addressPrompt.default: Address the {count} unresolved review threads on {url}. First check out {head}, fetch {base} from the remote the PR targets and merge it into {head} (no rebase), resolving any conflicts, so the fixes land on up-to-date code in the same push. Then, for each thread, fix the code when the remark is valid, otherwise explain why not, and reply to the thread.

mergePrompt.title: Merge-base prompt
mergePrompt.description: Sent when you press Behind/Conflicts (author mode). {url}, {base}, {head}
mergePrompt.default: Merge the latest {base} into {head} for {url}: check out {head}, fetch {base} from the remote the PR targets, merge it (no rebase), resolve any conflicts and check that it still builds.
